mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 5.0% per annum triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates labor market weakening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger period, or the unemployment rate does not cross the 5.0% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand-side GDP (GDPC1) and supply-side production (INDPRO) indices signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase over 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are not significantly positive in expanding economies.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% per annum signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during easing periods, or the regime is not active.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% per annum indicates labor market improvement, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the period of falling UNRATE, or the unemployment rate does not trend downward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2% per annum triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals aggressive monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS are below 2%, or in non-easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand-side GDP (GDPC1) and demand-driven industrial production (RSAFS) indices predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals robust economic activity.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase over 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are not significantly positive in expanding demand periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, sustained unemployment rates above 6% per annum trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged economic stagnation.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the high-unemployment period, or the unemployment rate does not exceed 6% in the regime.
